# caption_bbox

**In one sentence:** The CaptionBboxStep: writes a `.txt` caption for every image with a vision-language model (VLM — an AI model that looks at an image and writes text), optionally guided by boxes you draw around important parts.

## Why it exists
LoRA training needs one caption per image. This step generates them, lets you mark regions ("bbox" = bounding box) so the caption mentions what matters, and resumes where it left off so a re-run only captions what is missing or was judged bad.

## What's inside
| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `step.py` | Thin entry point: `run()` builds a `RealCaptionStep`. Also re-exports some `artifacts` helpers. |
| `base.py` | `CaptionStep`: the shared step flow (collect images, find pending ones, ask for boxes, caption, validate, report). Subclasses fill in a few hooks. |
| `real.py` | `RealCaptionStep`: the hooks backed by a Hugging Face VLM (`vlm.CaptionRuntime`). |
| `mock.py` | `MockCaptionStep`: same flow with fixed text, no model (the `--mock` runtime). `_mock_caption` is an older function wrapper around it. |
| `options.py` | `CaptionBboxRunOptions`: per-run inputs that are not in the project file (concept token, overwrite, quantization, status callback). |
| `vlm.py` | Loads and runs the caption model: quantization picked from GPU memory, remote-code policy, Qwen3 quirks, output cleanup. `CaptionRuntime` is the main class. |
| `grounded.py` | `generate_grounded_caption`: the three-pass "observe -> compose -> gap-fill" captioning used for prompt-following models. |
| `gap_fill.py` | Decides if a draft needs a gap pass, parses the missing phrases, and appends them without rewording the draft. |
| `prompts.py` | All built-in prompt texts and builders (full image, region, observe/compose/gap, box position words, `{concept_token}` placeholders). |
| `caption_text.py` | Text helpers: strip model "thinking" and boilerplate, word coverage checks, concept-token checks. |
| `workflow.py` | Per-image flow: `gather_decisions` (one batch box-drawing interaction), `resolve_decision`, writing captions. |
| `regions.py` | `make_region_captioner`: the callback the UI calls when you caption a drawn box; saves the crop + caption. |
| `artifacts.py` | Files for regions: `plk_bbox__<stem>__N.png/.txt` crops and `plk_bbox__<stem>__boxes.json` (saved boxes so they reload next time). |
| `validation.py` | After captioning: re-inserts dropped region labels, flags missing token / too short / too long, prints a random spot check. |
| `reports.py` | Success, skipped and failure report shapes for `CaptionBboxStep`. |

## How it works
- Input: the working dataset, a `CaptionBboxConfig`, and an optional concept token (no token = "style" mode).
- Pending images = no `.txt` yet, plus images the caption verifier marked `generic` or `wrong` (read from the verdict ledger `caption_verdicts.json` beside the report). `--force` makes every image pending.
- **annotate_regions**: one batch interaction lets you draw boxes per image (UI: `bbox_annotation`); skipped when headless.
- **caption_images**: each pending image is captioned. Prompt-following models use the grounded three-pass flow; others use one prompt (`caption_strategy: single`).
- Captions are cleaned, checked, and written as `<image>.txt` next to the image; the report lists captions, model info and pass counts.

## Who uses it
- `prepare_lora_kit/invoke/caption_bbox_step.py` — pipeline adapter (real or mock).
- `prepare_lora_kit/caption_prompts/prompt_registry.py` — uses `prompts.default_prompt_text` for the prompt library.
- `prepare_lora_kit/steps/caption_verifier/captions.py` — uses `_is_bbox_artifact` to skip region crops.
- `prepare_lora_kit_ui/bridge.py` / `static/steps/bbox_annotation/` — the box-drawing UI.
- Tests: `tests/steps/caption_bbox/`, `tests/pipeline/test_mock_caption.py`, `tests/cli/test_step_bbox.py`, `tests/utils/test_caption_prompt.py`, `tests/integration/steps/caption_bbox/`

## Good to know
- Unused: module-level `vlm.caption_image()` and `vlm.caption_region()` (everything calls the `CaptionRuntime` methods), and `artifacts._clean_bbox_artifacts` (only re-exported by `step.py`, never called — so the boxes sidecars are in practice never removed).
- Docstrings disagree on regions: `base.py`/`regions.py` say the real step captions a region "in the context of the full image", but `vlm.CaptionRuntime.caption_region` says the model sees "the crop only"; the box position is only added as a text hint.
- Models that ask to run their own Python code are refused unless the machine allows it (`_trust_remote_code`).
